node.statement: Let T(y)=Ay and h:=id-T. By the defining relation for the local fixed-point index in finite-dimensional Euclidean space, for any sufficiently small isolating ball V about 0 one has J(A,0):=J(T,0)=d(id-T,V)=d(h,V). The explicit dependency node 1.3.2, applying the permitted Brouwer-degree theorem GT-granas-dugundji-thm-8.4-brouwer-degree to this same h=I-A, gives d(h,V)=sgn det(I-A). Therefore J(A,0)=sgn det(I-A). This derivation does not use the compact extension G, germ or coordinate invariance, or node 1.3.1.
